notes: Positions are in the finished, upright model: x left to right, y front to back, layer in plates above the lowest piece (black base plate p49 = layer 0).

Step numbering: every sub-assembly box counts as its own step, and every main step counts too, 35 in all. Step 3 gives steps 3-6. Step 4 gives 7-8. Step 5 is 9. Step 6 gives 10-12. Step 7 gives 13-15. Step 8 is 16. Step 9 gives 17-19. Steps 10-21 are 20-31. Step 22 gives 32-33. Step 23 gives 34-35. Pieces are assigned to the sub-assembly step that builds them.

The booklet builds the body belt-first and flips the model upside down in steps 21-23 to attach the 2x2 plate p34, legs p24/p25, feet p35/p36 and finally the base p49. These pieces sit physically below the belt but are added later. A piece cannot rest on a later-added piece, so they have position null and their stud joins to p48/p49 are listed in other_joins. The belt p48 (layer 5) therefore floats above the base in the positions.

Bracket height: the positions use 3 plates for the bracket (lego-22885), as the catalogue seems to do, so p3/p4, ring 1 and ring 2 are each 3 plates tall. The physical part is 1 2/3 bricks (5 plates), and the booklet's centre stack (orange 2 bricks + round plate + pink brick = 10 plates) matches two real brackets. With the shorter heights the brown plates p17/p18/p29 and the top plate p46 no longer sit on the brackets in the positions, so those rests_on entries were dropped. p46 rests only on the pink brick p23.

Kept as is, not a real problem: p17/p18 (2x2 corner plates) are L-shaped, 3 studs each. p17 covers (1,2),(1,3),(2,3) and p18 covers (4,2),(4,3),(3,3), so neither covers the front-centre cells (2,2)/(3,2) where the door-rail plate p60 sits. Their 2x2 bounding boxes overlap p60, but the pieces do not. With p29 (2x4) the 16 cells of that layer are filled exactly once.

Base layout (4 wide by 6 deep, 2x4 print tile at the front, 1x4 plate and tile at the back row) and the ear-piece attachments are assumptions from small isometric pictures. Arms, face plates, eyes, ears and the back plate are attached sideways to the bracket side studs, so they have position null. The shield p67 is assumed to be held by the left-hand clip plate p66.
